short_reset_protocol.launch_count: Each paired profile remains one target process/one target kernel containing1/2/33 internal requests. No auxiliary reset kernel or re-launch. Short mode is untimed and does not export throughput; formal timer path contains no per-request poisoning/capture.
host_before_launch: G2S: prepare immutable logical global input including fixed rowpadding/guards; initialize full perrequest physical/logical capture arrays to complement of their expected values. Shared cannot be host-initialized.

S2G: initialize every logical element in all32 destination slots to complement(original shared-source expected value for thatCTA/row/column); initialize allpadding/guards separately. Initialize perrequest capture arrays to complement(original expected source). Untouched slots must retain this exact initialvalue.
Check uint64 allocation/offset for all request×CTA×Q capture arrays beforeallocation and record additional validation-only storage; no payload/work denominator change.
G2S_each_request: After prior request acquire+CTA gate and prior capture+CTA gate have completed, allthreads cooperatively write complement(expected current-slot logical element) into the mapped shared tile (none orSW128).
Every writing thread executes fence.proxy.async.shared::cta, then allCTA barrier before thread0 expectQ/issue/arrive/acquire sequence. Barrier control storage is never overwritten.

After acquire succeeds andCTA gate, cooperatively capture every raw physical tile element and every logical mapped element into disjoint perrequest global evidence arrays. CTA gate after all capture loads/stores before next sharedreset.
S2G_each_request: Shared source is prepared once before shortloop, everyproducer fence.proxy.async.shared::cta thenCTA gate; source remains unchanged.

After prior fullwait0+CTA gate and prior capture+CTA gate, allthreads reset only the selected global slot logical payload to complement(original sharedsource values); do not touch its padding/guards oranyotherCTA/slot.
Every global reset writer executes fence.proxy.async.global, thenCTA barrier before thread0 tensor store/commit/fullwait0. Thus generic reset precedes async destination writes across proxies.

After thread0 fullwait0 thenCTA gate, every capture consumer executes fence.proxy.async.global before loading all copied logical global elements into its disjoint perrequest evidence slice; CTA gate after capture before next globalreset.

Host validates every perrequest capture after kernel completion; additionally validate allvisited slots against originalsource and everyunvisited slot against its originally initialized complement(source), plus allpadding/guards.
short_reset_protocol.failure: Any timeout/incomplete copy/capture/poison/guard mismatch is failure; no retry or replacement launch hidden insideprofile.
